title: Necrosis: Cellular Injury and Mechanisms of Cell Death
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching paragraphs before Part B, excluding tables, figures, captions, practice, references and UI. Article includes headings, captions, table, questions and explanations, references; excludes SVG and zoom buttons.
comparator: 2.C.09: 6487 narrative words, 17 sections; 2.C.10: 8610 narrative words, 18 sections. Narrower necrosis roadmap receives 14 narrative sections and explicit causal/experimental analysis; count is not quality evidence alone.
scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 2.D p.3 and archived MP SET 2024 p.2 visually checked; SET wording not identical. Reviewed NCCD 2018, StatPearls, Kalogeris et al., Baines and Nakagawa 2005, Degterev 2005 and Assay Guidance Manual. First reviewer expanded actual discovery evidence, controls and prerequisites; second source review addressed free vs total calcium, transient dye permeability, mitochondrial inner vs outer membrane, ATP/ion balance, morphology and inflammation, secondary necrosis, regulated necrotic outcomes and assay limitations. Checked arithmetic (70, 1.25, 40%, 27.5%, 1.5 pp/min; practice 1.5, 50%, 42, 30%, 0.8 pp/min). Original questions/figures and explicitly hypothetical data.
limitations: Two editorial passes by the same assistant, not independent human peer review. Static source and arithmetic QA only; no rendered SVG, browser/device or accessibility audit. Current MPPSC-hosted SET syllabus not retrieved; archived 2024 comparator used. Immediate unpublished neighbors remain disabled until their publication. Live Pages separately pending.
